data: Bybit history-data, Contract, OB Data (daily ob200 files: one snapshot plus every update of the top 200 levels), rebuilt to the book at the end of each UTC minute; Bybit public trade archive for price, signed taker flow and volume. Price = last trade (as Binance klines in Parts 4-9). Depth = $ notional within 1% of mid.
day_validity: trade minutes >= 80%; merged depth minutes >= 80%; <= 5 update-id gaps; a book whose mid is > 3% from the last trade is treated as missing
inclusion: a coin enters if it has >= 8 valid training days and >= 24 valid test days; coins Bybit does not list are excluded
inference: Clark-West (Newey-West 6 lags); 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws (all symbols on a date together); secondary Holm-adjusted

primary.success: Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 AND 95% date-block bootstrap CI of dR2 above 0

question: A second venue with real depth: in the 20 thin-set coins on Bybit USDT perpetuals, does C3_hat forecast next-hour MAE beyond the Part 9 baseline (volatility forecasting, price impact, depth, hour effects)?
relation_to_part7: Part 7 tested Bybit with trades only (depth-free C3_flow) and failed. This is a new test with order-book depth on days Part 7 never used. Both results are reported.
runs: V6 is run once; every run is counted in prereg/test_set_unlocks_p10.json
unit: symbol-hour blocks, hours 6-23 UTC; features from minutes before t on the same day; outcome MAE over (t, t+60]
